notes: Starting cards as posted under Starting (10): Let Them Make The First Move / At Last We Will Have Revenge (posted on two lines, one card), Deep Hatred, Theed Palace Generator, Theed Palace Generator Core, Start Your Engines!, Sebulba's Podracer, Podrace Arena, Boonta Eve Podrace, Watto's Box, Fear Is My Ally; these count toward the 60.

The post is dated 28 October 2001, before Reflections III's 31 October release, but it is built around Reflections III cards (the objective, Lord Maul, Boba Fett, Bounty Hunter, Maul's Double-Bladed Lightsaber, Deep Hatred, Fear Is My Ally, the Dark Theed Palace sites and the ten Defensive Shields); the cards are kept as posted.
The Theed Palace sites, Podrace Arena and Boonta Eve Podrace dested to their Dark pages.

Posted 'Imperial Holotheatre' dested Executor: Holotheatre (the Holotheatre that Visage Of The Emperor uses); 'Choke Lord' Darth Vader, Dark Lord Of The Sith; 'Vader's Saber' Vader's Lightsaber (Premiere); 'Mara Jade' Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand; 'Omni Box & It's Worse' Ommni Box & It's Worse; 'Sebulba's Racer' Sebulba's Podracer.
Weapon Levitation dested the Dark Cloud City interrupt; Twi'lek Advisor the Dark Jabba's Palace interrupt.
Posted 28 October 2001 but built on Reflections III cards ('now that Reflections 3 is out'), so it is filed under Premiere - Reflections III.
